newsitem.title: GERMANY: South Africa sees strong interest in DM bond issue.
newsitem.headline: South Africa sees strong interest in DM bond issue.

text.p: South Africa has met strong interest from prospective investors in a 7-year, 400-500 million mark ($264.4 million) Eurobond which it plans to issue shortly, a top South African finance official said on Friday.
Finance Department director general Maria Ramos declined to give details of the issue but told a news conference she hoped that in view of the level of interest the terms would be attractive.
Ramos is part of a delegation of South African officials visiting European financial centres this week.
South Africa's Eurobond will be its second mark denominated Eurobond issue. It issued a five-year, 10.25 percent, 400 million mark bond in 1991.
"The high level of interest we have seen lets us expect an attractive issue," Ramos said.
The issue will be lead managed by Deutsche Morgan Grenfell and Morgan Stanley. The yield spread is expected to be 130 to 150 basis points over Bunds.
